text.p: Healthdyne Technologies said on Thursday it engaged Cowen & Co as its financial adviser and Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP as its legal advisor in response to an acquisition offer from Invacare Corp.
"We will respond to the Invacare offer after our advisers have had an opportunity to provide to the board of directors their advice," President and Chief Executive Craig Reynolds said.
Invacare said on January 10 it offered to acquire Healthdyne in negotiated deal for $12.50 per share in cash. Healthdyne said then it would consider the bid in due course.
Reynolds said the company remained confident in its strategic plan and growth potential. Healthdyne designs, maeks and markets advanced medical devices.
